content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The sources provide several details about welfare measures for transgender persons: [E01] Recommendations include sensitizing police and hospital staff to prevent discrimination, providing job reservations, ensuring transgender representation in census, issuing identity documents with a transgender column, establishing a Transgender Welfare Board with insurance and medical-claim facilities, creating transgender police stations for security, and extending housing benefits. [E02] Additional measures include free education without reserved quotas, employment opportunities, proper sanitation facilities, and representation in local government and legislatures. [E03] Current government schemes include skill development and livelihood programs (targeting 21,000 persons with 6,580 lakhs rupees over 5 years), health insurance coverage through Ayushman Bharat Plus including sex reassignment surgeries, and support for self-employment and income-generating activities through loans and self-help groups, all subject to social audit.", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02", "E03"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "Welfare measures include sensitizing police and hospital staff, job reservations, census inclusion, identity documents, Transgender Welfare Board, insurance facilities, and housing benefits", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Additional measures include free education, employment opportunities, sanitation facilities, and political representation", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Government schemes provide skill development for 21,000 persons, health insurance including surgeries, and support for self-employment", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}]}
